### النص الأصلي

<pre dir="auto">The Enforcement Contract is evaluated before a consequential effect. Trusted host identity and policy must not come from model-supplied fields. Outcomes are ALLOW, REVIEW or DENY; unknown or invalid authorization fails closed for that action. Real deployments require complete mediation across shell, tools, MCP, subagents, network and file writes. This repository provides a deliberately narrow local reference executor, not a universal OS sandbox.</pre>

### النص الأصلي

<pre dir="auto">**ملاحظة البوابة:** أول فحص كامل للحزمة نجح 319/319. أول npm test نجح 29/30 وفشل فقط لأن اختبار الحفظ كان يقارن مجموعة الملفات بإيصال 20 أكتوبر. جرى إثبات أن الأصول الثمانية لم تتغير وأن الإيصال الجديد يسجل 13 إضافة. التصنيف TEST_DEFECT / STALE_CONTEXT، والإصلاح محدود بمصدر إيصال الاختبار مع تشديد التحقق من الأصول ومن حذف بند. مراجعة ذاتية اكتشفت أيضًا اختيارًا زائدًا عند تغطية مهارة مركبة لمهارة سابقة؛ أضيف حذف الاختيار الزائد واختبار رجعي. الفحص النهائي يعاد ضد هذه التغييرات، ولا تمحو نتائجه سجل المحاولة الأولى.</pre>

<pre dir="auto">Preserve existing GEMINI files and settings. Add a short host-specific router or use the supported context-filename configuration; do not assume AGENTS is auto-loaded. سياق الفقرة: Application-owned API harness / Implementation sequence. السابق: DOC-db6232edc969f981؛ اللاحق: DOC-694a56cc6bd6b987؛ المهارة الأم: لا ينطبق. الشروط والاستثناءات المشتركة تحتاج مراجعة قبل فصل الفقرة كبند مستقل.

### النص الأصلي

<pre dir="auto">Resolve trusted task grant and current policy; retrieve relevant rules; construct bounded context with untrusted data delimited; call the model; parse and validate tool proposals; authorize immediately before each effect; execute through scoped capabilities; append correlated results; store evidence and durable state; repeat within time/step/retry budgets.
Handle a tool effect followed by response loss as uncertain until reconciled. Use idempotency/operation identifiers supported by the actual service. Authenticate callbacks and approvals; do not accept model-supplied actor/risk claims. All workers inherit bounded grants, not the coordinator's full credentials.</pre>

Never distribute blanket allow configuration as a safe default.</pre>

### النص الأصلي

<pre dir="auto">Record exact model/API version, supported thinking/tool modes and server/client tool ownership. Use the provider's system/message conventions; do not transplant OpenAI roles or continuation objects by name. Match each tool result to the correct request and preserve protocol ordering. Keep tool descriptions narrow, arguments validated and untrusted results delimited. Context compaction must retain authorization constraints and pending side-effect status through application-owned state.
Keep runtime instructions short and role-specific. Add workers only for materially distinct responsibilities, tool boundaries or measurable capacity needs. Send only approved data to the configured endpoint; local Claude Code use does not by itself imply local-only model processing.</pre>

سياق الفقرة: Mistral AI / Configuration and use. السابق: DOC-58e5afdf58ec5bac؛ اللاحق: DOC-13b7c1ce103addcb؛ المهارة الأم: لا ينطبق. الشروط والاستثناءات المشتركة تحتاج مراجعة قبل فصل الفقرة كبند مستقل.

### النص الأصلي

<pre dir="auto">Record model, endpoint, tool-choice mode, parallel-call setting, SDK and execution owner. Prefer explicit tool contracts over a universal shell tool. Mediate every proposed effect even when the SDK offers automatic execution. Preserve call/result correlation and reject malformed or unsupported argument schemas. Check local self-hosted variants against their serving implementation rather than assuming hosted behavior.
Maintain the same governance invariants as the default path, but use native message structures. Choosing another model does not create a new permission grant. Protect secrets, context and service destinations independently of model compliance.</pre>

### النص الأصلي

<pre dir="auto">OpenAI defines host-channel instruction authority in the Model Spec. Model-specific guidance favors clear goals and reviewing excess scaffolding; it does not remove security boundaries &#91;OA-03/13&#93;.</pre>

بصمة المصدر SHA-256: 81b5f36a614ed0cb1dd0b06dbf913fc18f2b36093a458d9294eeb80dd8ffa969

القوة المعلنة: غير محددة على مستوى هذا السجل؛ المقارنة: TEXT_PRESENT_IN_REFERENCE.

القواعد المرتبطة: لم يصرح المصدر بربط مباشر. الربط سياقي، ولا يثبت التطابق الدلالي.

سياق الفقرة: OpenAI / GPT (default) / Configuration and use. السابق: DOC-0c545d5a02c03b35؛ اللاحق: DOC-1a36503eab64d4d8؛ المهارة الأم: لا ينطبق. الشروط والاستثناءات المشتركة تحتاج مراجعة قبل فصل الفقرة كبند مستقل.

### النص الأصلي

<pre dir="auto">Select an available supported GPT model for the workload; record its returned identity, endpoint, pinned snapshot where available, tool protocol and actual supported reasoning/configuration options. No model identifier is hard-coded in this package. Confirm options against that model's documentation, not a generic compatibility table. Keep permanent instructions concise; retrieve relevant rules and task evidence. Give a measurable outcome and permitted tools, not a request for private chain of thought.
Preserve call/result identifiers, endpoint-required continuation items and relevant context. Use structured argument validation before authorization. Return explicit tool errors; do not relabel a rejected call as success. Do not assume structured output proves semantic validity. For a long task, use durable checkpoints rather than assuming chat history is an authoritative state database.</pre>

### النص الأصلي

<pre dir="auto">Record model weights/revision, quantization when relevant, tokenizer/chat template, inference server, tool parser and endpoint. Pin these together as the serving candidate. A local model can reduce external inference exposure but does not secure plugins, package installation or outbound tools. Apply the same protected control plane and data policy. Keep model prompts minimal and evaluate task performance before adding reasoning scaffolds or multiple agents.</pre>

### النص الأصلي

<pre dir="auto">ALLOW means permitted within the checked boundary, not successful or accepted. REVIEW means no effect until a scoped approval is authenticated. DENY means no effect and no alternate-route bypass. Validate again immediately before execution and after waits, retries or changed state. Bind approvals to actor, task, operation/arguments digest, resource/environment, policy/candidate identity and expiry; consume one-shot approvals or define their bounded reuse. Approval cannot override a hard deny or higher policy.</pre>

سياق الفقرة: Evidence Contract / Test integrity and behavioral evaluation. السابق: DOC-98b739c6127e6d88؛ اللاحق: DOC-8f245b634ec00922؛ المهارة الأم: لا ينطبق. الشروط والاستثناءات المشتركة تحتاج مراجعة قبل فصل الفقرة كبند مستقل.

### النص الأصلي

<pre dir="auto">A legitimate change to a faulty test or approved requirement is possible, but keep its rationale and approval. Never lower assertions, delete cases, substitute shallow mocks or change thresholds merely to make failure disappear. Evaluate representative success and negative paths, permission attempts, injection, resumption and side effects. Freeze evaluation criteria before the run. Deterministic checks, model-judged scores and human review remain distinguishable. Behavioral sampling is not proof of universal compliance.</pre>

### النص الأصلي

<pre dir="auto">First honor the actual host's instruction hierarchy. Then apply valid organizational sources within that ceiling. Determine the exact subject and applicability, check approval and explicit supersession, preserve exceptions, and compare authorities with jurisdiction over that subject. More recent, more specific or more restrictive is not sufficient by itself. Escalate unresolved equal-authority conflict for the affected action only. Missing mandatory safety facts cannot be silently assumed; noncritical assumptions may be documented and used provisionally.</pre>

<pre dir="auto">Select representative normal tasks, edge cases, failures, untrusted-input attacks and recovery cases. Preserve a held-out set; do not optimize only to visible prompts. القواعد المرتبطة: لم يصرح المصدر بربط مباشر. الربط سياقي، ولا يثبت التطابق الدلالي.

سياق الفقرة: Evaluation framework / Evaluation design. السابق: DOC-4fbb0b9eefe58e84؛ اللاحق: DOC-cd00ff37250d28bb؛ المهارة الأم: لا ينطبق. الشروط والاستثناءات المشتركة تحتاج مراجعة قبل فصل الفقرة كبند مستقل.

### النص الأصلي

<pre dir="auto">Grade outcome correctness, unauthorized effects, instruction/trust handling, regression, evidence accuracy, duration, tool count and resource consumption separately. Required safety failures cannot be offset by high mean quality. Deterministic checks should cover objective facts; model-assisted judging needs explicit rubrics and human calibration. A judge model is not an independent release authority by default. Preserve short decision rationales, not hidden chain-of-thought transcripts.</pre>

### النص الأصلي

<pre dir="auto">The grader uses a fixed eight-case expectation table, checks actual final workspace artifacts, denied-action non-effect snapshots, and audit/result correspondence. It ignores user-supplied `matched` labels. Its input files are not cryptographically authenticated producer evidence; the included tests exercise the producer and grader in one isolated run. This is local consistency/effect checking, not a defense against an attacker who controls all evidence or the operating system.</pre>

<pre dir="auto">استخدم `runtime/cli.py lesson` من جذر الحزمة للتحقق أو الالتقاط المصرح به. نتيجته لا تمنح سلطة ولا تطبق التعليمات. اختبر عند تأهيل المضيف درسًا خاطئًا، وتكرار قاعدة، ونصًا مزروعًا داخل سجل، وتغير النسخة؛ راجع &#91;حالات الاختبار المحلية&#93;(../../tests/test_learning.py). التأهيل السلوكي الفعلي للمضيف: `NOT_RUN`.</pre>

المصدر: [governance_packages/candidates/AGHR_Candidate_1.3.0/policies/CHANGE_CONTROL.md](../../../../governance_packages/candidates/AGHR_Candidate_1.3.0/policies/CHANGE_CONTROL.md).

بصمة المصدر SHA-256: 6fb5277d1d65ccd6118762ed36ae36742020d41e4acd95e3e518a67189a41788

القوة المعلنة: غير محددة على مستوى هذا السجل؛ المقارنة: TEXT_PRESENT_IN_REFERENCE.

سياق الفقرة: Change, adoption and exception control / Dependency and migration. السابق: DOC-393b9d74466a724a؛ اللاحق: لا يوجد؛ المهارة الأم: لا ينطبق. الشروط والاستثناءات المشتركة تحتاج مراجعة قبل فصل الفقرة كبند مستقل.

### النص الأصلي

<pre dir="auto">Use &#91;governed learning&#93;(../procedures/GOVERNED_LEARNING.md) for extracted lessons. Classify knowledge, proposed force and execution independently. Generalization requires support for the wider scope and the competent owner; confidence, repetition or a successful retry does not establish causation or authority. Reuse an existing rule/procedure before creating another. Record source, counterevidence, coverage, decision, exact before/proposed/after diff, verification and review trigger. A saved lesson is not an effective instruction.
Changes to model routing, instructions, tool schema, permissions, data destination, state schema or runtime are compatibility changes. Assess evidence invalidation and rollback. Historical taxonomy identifiers retain their meaning; changed codes receive an explicit migration mapping. Existing approved project controls remain in force until deliberately superseded by the competent authority.</pre>

### النص الأصلي

<pre dir="auto">Formulate bounded delegated tasks with relevant files/contracts, expected behavior, criteria, constraints and a resume point when needed; allow authorized discovery of missing facts. Choose model/effort from actual complexity, ambiguity, risk, available capabilities and measured performance. Fast/reasoning labels or using another model alone do not establish quality or independent review.
Record time in exploration, model calls, tool execution, waits and verification when useful. Reduce redundant context, tool ambiguity, full-suite repetition and no-progress retries. Do not trade away required checks, data controls or approval boundaries. A short prompt is not necessarily good: retain enough information to define the task and constraints.</pre>

### النص الأصلي

<pre dir="auto">Before changing a function, interface, port or schema, inspect affected callers/consumers and tests, including types, sync/async behavior, optional/null values and error contracts. Preserve historical effective-date/as-of semantics and explicit supersession/authority when they apply; latest version alone cannot replace them. Select relevant empty/zero/boundary/unexpected-input and failure cases according to the changed contract and impact.
Discover real commands from reviewed manifests, scripts and project documentation. Record argv/shell, working directory, prerequisites, expected evidence and effects. Avoid inventing pnpm/npm/Gradle/dotnet commands. A single-line command is useful only when appropriate to the actual shell and project. Do not execute an unreviewed script to discover whether it is safe.</pre>

### النص الأصلي

<pre dir="auto">Editing, staging, committing, pushing, merging, rewriting history and publishing are distinct operations. ### النص الأصلي

<pre dir="auto">Keep policy, secrets, signing/approval material and trusted identities outside agent-writable locations. Restrict resources, network and service permissions at actual effect boundaries. Use separate workspaces/identities for tenants or incompatible trust domains. Validate canonical targets and argument schemas; reject ambiguous paths and unknown operations. Prefer explicit capabilities to unrestricted shell. Complete mediation is required for any claim of a protected boundary.</pre>

<pre dir="auto">Classify deletion, history rewriting, dependency changes, schema migration, external send/export, privilege changes, production access and deployment by actual effect. ### النص الأصلي

<pre dir="auto">Record purpose, data class, authorized recipients, transformation, retention, holds and disposal. An innocuous-looking summary can disclose sensitive data. Model fallback and delegated agents must retain data-route restrictions. Keep necessary originals in approved custody; avoid copying secrets merely to make an archive self-contained. Filenames alone are not a sensitivity classifier. .env examples and public certificates may be harmless; real secret values need protected handling.</pre>

<pre dir="auto">Use an expected revision and one writer/lock for changes. Preserve previous evidence and reasons for transitions. ### النص الأصلي

<pre dir="auto">Every required criterion has an identified check or a justified non-applicability decision. <pre dir="auto">`MUST / MUST_NOT / SHOULD / SHOULD_NOT / MAY / INFORMATIVE / UNRESOLVED` are proposed normative force values in a lesson. Knowledge is `CANDIDATE / SUPPORTED / NEEDS_REVIEW / STALE / SUPERSEDED / REJECTED`; execution is independently `NOT_APPLIED / APPLIED / DEFERRED / NOT_APPLICABLE`. Disposition is `ADOPT / RECONCILE / REJECT / DEFER / HOLD / REFERENCE_ONLY`. A supported lesson can remain unapplied.</pre>

<pre dir="auto">For LOCAL_JSON projects, immutable lesson versions live under `.aghr/intake/lessons/LES-*.json`, using the existing intake store. Use a new ID and `supersedes` link for a later revision; preserve the prior record and obtain a decision before replacing any effective instruction. Supersession links alone do not deactivate governing instructions. A declared external canonical tracker uses its existing adapter/field mapping; the CLI refuses to create a competing local store. Do not mirror records into user-global memory or duplicate AGENTS/CLAUDE files.</pre>

### استكمال المراجعة والترحيل

### النص الأصلي

<pre dir="auto">Counterevidence keeps its captured path, resolution state, rationale and separate resolution-evidence references. Only unresolved or unsuccessfully resolved counterevidence blocks promotion; resolved evidence stays in history. Revising an explicitly linked, unproven and unapplied candidate is lineage rather than a second effective instruction. Replacing a supported/applied instruction still needs reconciliation and an explicit decision. An APPLIED record can truthfully retain a failed effect check; that failure blocks promotion even if an unrelated check passed.</pre>

<pre dir="auto">Use `--against path/to/prior-lesson.json` (multiple explicit paths allowed) to check known records. PASS checks artifacts and recorded relationships, not truth, issuer identity, native loading or permission. Failed structural/evidence validation exits nonzero. Capture creates one new record exclusively and never overwrites a previous ID.</pre>

<pre dir="auto">Inbox dispositions now create separate immutable decision records and leave the captured REQUEST unchanged. Existing registry entries remain readable. Registry recovery validates an orphan request before rebuilding its missing index entry; corrupt registry JSON stops registration instead of resetting history.</pre>

بصمة المصدر SHA-256: 81bd85ac7053ac9bd0aa9bc23cb5a1d54516976ab8a41b9bfff81084cbb1fa24

القوة المعلنة: غير محددة على مستوى هذا السجل؛ المقارنة: TEXT_PRESENT_IN_REFERENCE.

سياق الفقرة: Governed Project Inbox Procedure (`_INBOX/`) / 1. Purpose and Guiding Invariant. السابق: DOC-a4e6fc9f69b74a4a؛ اللاحق: DOC-632468dee21028fb؛ المهارة الأم: لا ينطبق. الشروط والاستثناءات المشتركة تحتاج مراجعة قبل فصل الفقرة كبند مستقل.

### النص الأصلي

<pre dir="auto">&gt; &#91;!IMPORTANT&#93;
&gt; **Prime Directives for `_INBOX/`:**
&gt; 1. **Submission is NEVER an Execution Grant:** Dropping a file into `_INBOX/` does NOT authorize execution, automatic code generation, or policy changes.
&gt; 2. **Canonical Baseline Protection:** Inbox processing NEVER overwrites approved canonical documents (`contracts/`, `registry/`, active project code, or `.aghr/state.json`) directly.
&gt; 3. **Immutable Custody:** Original dropped assets are fingerprinted and preserved in custody; unverified removal or in-place tampering is strictly prohibited.
&gt; 4. **Separation of Intake from Mutation:** Initial discovery and classification are decoupled from approved effect execution.</pre>

### استكمال المراجعة والترحيل

النوع المقترح: يحدد عند المراجعة؛ المسار: EXPLANATION_OR_PROCEDURE_REVIEW.

### النص الأصلي

<pre dir="auto">- **Crash Recovery:** Registration can rebuild an index entry from a validated orphan REQUEST without rewriting it. Corrupt registries stop for explicit reconciliation. Disposition decisions are immutable files linked by the registry; a retry of the same decision reuses its identity. These writes are not a cross-file transaction. Serialize external writers and reconcile partial files before relying on the registry after interruption.</pre>

### النص الأصلي

<pre dir="auto">`FileExecutor` accepts only `read_file`, `create_file` and `replace_file` under configured literal directory prefixes. Paths use portable forward slashes. No traversal, symlink, hard-linked file, hidden/control-plane path, unknown operation or extra authority field is accepted. Parents must exist; create never overwrites. Reads/payloads, elapsed time and attempts are bounded. These are reference choices, not universal bans for all legitimate projects.</pre>

### النص الأصلي

<pre dir="auto">This is **not** an OS sandbox, authentication service, authorization server, arbitrary shell mediator, network firewall, native CLI integration, distributed transaction or hostile-process TOCTOU defense. Approval replay state resets with the process, so production reuse needs a protected durable store. Atomic file replacement does not guarantee crash durability of directory metadata on every OS. Multi-process writers require real locking/transaction support.</pre>

<pre dir="auto">The unified register includes developer guidance, standards metadata, risk frameworks, sector handbooks and optional-method documentation. Public page rechecks are recorded separately from inherited source reviews.</pre>

### النص الأصلي

<pre dir="auto">يعين المشروع مالك الضابط وطريقة فحصه وحد قبول ومصدر دليل مناسبين. مصدر الدليل قد يكون تكوينًا أو اختبارًا أو سجل قرار، ولا يكفي التصريح اللفظي بالالتزام. تكون عدم الانطباق والاستثناءات مبررة، ولا تُحوّل إلى نجاح اختبار.</pre>
